verdict.rationale: Daytona is sandbox infrastructure for AI agents. A built-in assistant, such as a dashboard copilot, is a fair question for a platform like this, so the axis applies. The pack shows no AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server and agent skill let external agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) drive Daytona; that is adjacent integration, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
